title: HOPE ON THE STREET - The Dancer Never Left
story:
Before j-hope became a global music star, he was a dancer. And no matter how far his career took him, that dancer was always part of who he was.

FROM HOPE ON THE STREET TO A GLOBAL JOURNEY

In **2015**, he began sharing short dance practice videos under the name **HOPE ON THE STREET**. Almost a decade later, he returned to that idea with a much bigger project: a six-part documentary series and a special album, **HOPE ON THE STREET VOL.1**.

The documentary, released in **March 2024**, followed j-hope as he revisited the roots of his artistic journey. Accompanied by his former dance instructor, the legendary popping dancer **Boogaloo Kin**, he travelled to **Osaka, Seoul, Paris, New York, and his hometown of Gwangju**.

Along the way, he met talented street dancers from different backgrounds and explored styles including popping, locking, house, and hip-hop. These encounters were not simply dance lessons. They were opportunities to exchange ideas, learn from other artists, and connect through movement - a language that does not need words.

RETURNING TO HIS ROOTS

One of the most meaningful parts of the journey was returning to **Gwangju** and reconnecting with **NEURON**, the dance crew that had been part of his life before his debut with BTS. Dancing alongside the people who had witnessed the beginning of his journey brought his story full circle.

THE MUSIC OF HOPE ON THE STREET

The documentary was accompanied by **HOPE ON THE STREET VOL.1**, released on **March 29, 2024**. The six-track album explored different musical styles and collaborations while keeping street dance at its heart. j-hope participated in writing and composing all six tracks.

The album featured a variety of artists: **Jung Kook** joined him on "i wonder...", **benny blanco and Nile Rodgers** collaborated on "lock / unlock", **HUH YUNJIN of LE SSERAFIM** appeared on "i don't know", and **Jinbo the SuperFreak** contributed to the dance mix of "what if...". The title track, **"NEURON"**, featured **Gaeko and Yoon Mirae** and was named after the dance crew that had helped shape j-hope's early years.

THE DANCER NEVER LEFT

This project was deeply personal. It was not about proving that he could still dance or showing off his skills. It was about reconnecting with the passion that had started everything, appreciating the people who had helped him along the way, and discovering how much he still had to learn.

After years of performing on the world's biggest stages, j-hope returned to the streets - not as a beginner, but as an artist who had never forgotten where he came from.

The dancer never left. He was always there, moving forward.

challenge.question: What was the title track of HOPE ON THE STREET VOL.1 named after?
options: The dance crew NEURON, which j-hope was part of before his BTS debut.
The first dance academy j-hope attended in Gwangju.
A street dance festival in New York.
challenge.answer: The dance crew NEURON, which j-hope was part of before his BTS debut.
challenge.explanation: The title track "NEURON" was named after the Gwangju-based dance crew that played an important role in j-hope's pre-debut years.
